how_served: Next.js site backed by Sanity CMS (project m6i10uln, public read). /companies HTML renders only 22 featured cards; full list (196 company docs) only via Sanity GROQ API / client JS. sitemap.xml lists only 13 /companies/ pages and 55 /team pages.
thesis: Seed-stage ("first round") investor; backs founders who go unreasonably deep on their beginnings, outlier/extreme abilities over well-rounded; 500+ early teams; sector-agnostic (consumer, enterprise, fintech, health, AI); US-focused (SF, NYC). Flagship: Uber, Square, Notion, Roblox, Looker, Clay.
